name: Apollo.io
instructions: Apollo files people by work email. Open https://www.apollo.io/privacy-policy/remove, enter each of these addresses (one at a time), finish the robot check, and open the link Apollo sends to that address: {all_emails}. Then press "I've done this".
notes: Usually done within 1 to 7 days. If nothing changes after a week, write to Apollo's privacy address.
source: Steps per ClearNym's Apollo opt-out guide.
